          <h1>Join a local network. Meet in more than one way.</h1>

          </p>

            <span>No endless feed</span>

            <span>No fake urgency</span>

            <p>

            </p>

              <h3>Start where there are enough people nearby.</h3>
              <p>

              </p>
              <p class="strategy-proof">You get · Honest waitlists and no fake countdowns</p>

              <h3>The network refreshes. Mutual states stay optional.</h3>

            <h2>If it isn’t mutual, nothing changes.</h2>
            <p>
              A request never becomes a relationship state by itself. Focus and Together begin only after both people
              choose them independently .. and either person can still leave respectfully.
